notes.title: NEW DEMO OUT!
notes.content:
After the first demo was released back in December 2023, I received a lot of feedback, and working for the next 7 months on it, I thought you guys deserved a better, longer, and more polished experience, here are the most important changes made from [i]Demo 1[/i] to [i]Demo 2[/i]:

[b]General Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a second variation of the Chase Theme from each killer. 
[*] Balanced the movement speed of The Mad Doc when searching.
[*] Re-worked most of the maps to make them look more detailed, and balanced.
[*] Added a new item: "Adrenaline Shot" - Increases your movement speed for a few minutes.
[*] Re-mapped the "Sliding" key mechanic from "ALT" to "F".
[*] Added a player model. 
[*] Updated the title card reveal, now it's a more interesting sequence.
[*] Added a new opening credits video. 
[/list]

Also, many bugs have been fixed, here are the most crucial ones:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the movement speed of the character to depend on the frame rate.
[*] Fixed an issue where you had to click on the inventory to be able to close it.
[*] Fixed many issues related to "GOD ZONES", where the player couldn't be harmed.
[*] 
[/list]

Hopefully this build will reflect much better the final build, set to release next year :)
